scripts.local: devbox run llm & devbox run backend & devbox run front
scripts.backend: mkdir -p data/fastapi && . $VENV_DIR/bin/activate && cd backend && pip install -q -e '.[dev]' && LLM_URL=http://localhost:${LLM_PORT:-8080}/v1/chat/completions HISTORY_PATH=../data/fastapi/history.json EMPTY_HISTORY_PATH=../data/fastapi/history_empty.json uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port ${BACKEND_PORT:-8000}
scripts.test: . $VENV_DIR/bin/activate && cd backend && pip install -q -e '.[dev]' && pytest -v && cd ../frontend && npm install --silent && npm test
